Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: include rolling window columns in scale_weather_features

Window cols (12h/24h/72h) were present in the training data but
bypassed RobustScaler — only ALL_WEATHER_FEATURES (12 basic cols)
were being scaled. Uses same pattern detection as filter_columns.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: coerce object-dtype weather/window columns to numeric before median imputation

Source parquets store some columns (e.g. Precipitation amount 72h mean/cumulative)
as object dtype with string values. Window columns bypass the coercion in
add_weather_scenarios_col, causing handle_missing_values median computation to fail.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
fix: add pattern-based rolling window column detection in filter_columns

fix: exclude categorical targets from numeric coercion to prevent silent data loss

pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') turns string-encoded booleans like 'True'/'False'
into NaN, which caused the subsequent dropna to silently drop all rows when
trainDelayed or cancelled arrived as object dtype. Fix narrows the coercion loop
to numeric-only target columns (VALID_TARGET_FEATURES minus CATEGORIAL_TARGET_FEATURES)
and adds CATEGORIAL_TARGET_FEATURES to the import. Also fixes non-ASCII arrow in
logger.info message. New regression test covers the string-boolean path.
